snippet.title: DUAL PROTOCOL: The Case of Eva & Miles | First Trailer
snippet.description:
Play as Agent Eva and investigate in the field, or become Analyst Miles and manage the operation. Dual Protocol is an asymmetric co-op noir puzzle game where two players progress only through communication. Without seeing each other’s screens, combine the information you have and uncover the truth behind the Castellari murder.

Now on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4660280/DUAL_PROTOCOL_The_Case_of_Eva__Miles/
